reserveReview.rationale: audm-mento retains the shared Mento Reserve backing model. All positive holdings are refreshed from one issuer API capture. Native parents keep their canonical collateral link; Celo axlUSDC and axlEUROC and Monad USDT0 carry explicit bridge annotations with registry contracts and fixed-block symbols confirmed at Celo 78860375 and Monad 109288367. Bridge verification establishes representation identity and documented issuer lineage, not independent escrow solvency. GBPm, JPYm and CHFm remain separate USDm-collateral CDPs; no underlying basket is duplicated on those coins. Source-scoped correction (retrieved 2026-10-20): AUSD liquidityHorizon immediate is withdrawn to unknown. Agora Bermuda Terms of Use as of 2026-09-01, page 6 (https://static.agora.finance/termsofuse.pdf), limits direct redemption to verified customers, aims at 48 business hours normally or 96 under stress, and reserves delay and in-kind payout rights. Instant Settlement (https://docs.agora.finance/instant-settlement) is whitelist-only and Agora-inventory-managed; neither reviewed source proves the shared Reserve can realize its complete AUSD position immediately. This is a scoped liquidity classification correction, not a changed composition or a finding that redemption has failed. All original review/composition dates, reserve amounts and source keys remain unchanged.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer reserve API collateral.assets captured 2026-09-30; measured percentages grouped by native economic parent with axlUSDC, axlEUROC and USDT0 retained separately. Capture date is an observation date; the API supplies no independently verified source update clock.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All captured holdings have reviewed identities. Bridge custody and current escrow reconciliation are not independently assured. The live source freshness gate is unchanged.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: AUDm's shared Mento Reserve assets are held in on-chain reserve safes, liquidity contracts, operational accounts, and governance-approved strategies rather than a borrower-specific USDm CDP. Legal segregation, insolvency treatment, and strategy-specific reuse limits are not established by the reviewed sources; constituent-level custody sits with each asset's issuer or protocol. Source-scoped correction (2026-10-20): the prior mixed segregation and conditional rehypothecation labels were not established by their own dashboard/protocol sources, whose uncertainty statement already says the legal safeguards and reuse limits are unestablished. Both are corrected to unknown without asserting either protection or its absence. The re-read issuer reserve documentation, dashboard and MGP-19 do not supply complete enforceable whole-material-book segregation/reuse terms. Original review start, custody providers and all composition evidence remain unchanged.
